_about: Recycle flowsheets solved equation-oriented (scipy root on the flows of the reference_tears) with the independent flash of reference_flash.py; validation/python/reference_flowsheet_suite.py (seed 20261008). docs/FLOWSHEET_TESTS.md explains the suite. Do not edit by hand.

published.source: E. M. Rosen, VMGSim: Revisiting the Cavett Problem, CACHE News Fall (2005), https://cache.org/sites/default/files/fall2005_rosen_cavett.pdf
published.notes: FLOWTRAN's P1 ethane, 2883.2, is above the feed (2395.5); Rosen reads it as a typo for 2383.2. FLOWTRAN's products do not close the component balances (Rosen's last column); VMGSim's do. P1 is the vapour of FL1, P2 the liquid of FL4 (Figure 2). Rosen's text says P2 is the liquid of FL2; Figure 2 and the stated conditions (85 F, 13 psia) are those of FL4.

why: V2 at 112.1 K is below the melting point of a component present (143.5 K)
V2: a second liquid (thermo FlashVLN), outside the domain of a cubic equation of state
